name.es: Orquestador de validacion sobre el motor real: consolidar, publicar eventos y bloquear
name.en: Validation orchestrator over the real engine: consolidate, publish events and block

pre.es: Directorio temporal escribible con metamodelo, expresion, acciones y regla guardados en repositorios JSON reales.
pre.en: Writable temp directory with the metamodel, expression, actions and rule saved in real JSON repositories.

setup.es: Sin mocks: ValidationRuntimeApplicationService real (relee del disco), ValidationEngine real, DefaultValidationBlockingPolicy real y bus de eventos real con un suscriptor que anota los tipos publicados.
setup.en: No mocks: real ValidationRuntimeApplicationService (rereads from disk), real ValidationEngine, real DefaultValidationBlockingPolicy and a real event bus with a subscriber recording published types.

executes.es: ValidationOrchestrator.validate con modos FULL, INCREMENTAL y SELECTION sobre un modelo canonico editado entre ejecuciones, con las puertas NONE, SAVE y EXPORT.
executes.en: ValidationOrchestrator.validate in FULL, INCREMENTAL and SELECTION modes over a canonical model edited between runs, with the NONE, SAVE and EXPORT gates.

asserts.es: El informe completo detecta al empleado con edad negativa; la revalidacion incremental lo resuelve y publica violation-resolved; SELECTION conserva el problema fuera de la seleccion; NONE no bloquea, SAVE y EXPORT bloquean con errores y EXPORT se libera por configuracion.
asserts.en: The full report finds the employee with a negative age; incremental revalidation resolves it and publishes violation-resolved; SELECTION keeps the problem outside the selection; NONE never blocks, SAVE and EXPORT block on errors and EXPORT is released by configuration.

behavior.es: Tras corregir un problema, la siguiente validacion parcial lo da por resuelto sin perder los demas, avisa por eventos y decide si se puede guardar o exportar.
behavior.en: After fixing a problem, the next partial validation marks it resolved without losing the others, announces it through events and decides whether saving or exporting is allowed.

rule.es: Los errores bloquean guardar y exportar salvo que la configuracion lo desactive; la puerta NONE nunca bloquea; bloquear no altera los diagnosticos.
rule.en: Errors block saving and exporting unless configuration disables it; the NONE gate never blocks; blocking does not alter the diagnostics.

scenario.es: Dos ejecuciones sobre el mismo modelo (completa e incremental), una pareja completa/seleccion con dos problemas y una secuencia de puertas NONE, SAVE, EXPORT, EXPORT sin bloqueo y SAVE sobre modelo corregido.
scenario.en: Two runs over the same model (full and incremental), a full/selection pair with two problems and a gate sequence NONE, SAVE, EXPORT, EXPORT unblocked and SAVE over a fixed model.

result.es: Los diagnosticos, el delta (creados, sin cambios, resueltos), los eventos y la decision de bloqueo coinciden con los valores literales esperados.
result.en: Diagnostics, the delta (created, unchanged, resolved), events and the blocking decision match the literal expected values.

expected.es: Todas las aserciones pasan con el motor real sin simulaciones.
expected.en: All assertions pass with the real engine and no mocks.

guarantee.es: La consolidacion de informes parciales, la publicacion de eventos y la politica de bloqueo funcionan con reglas realmente guardadas y evaluadas.
guarantee.en: Consolidation of partial reports, event publication and the blocking policy work with rules that are really saved and evaluated.

limits.es: No usa sesion EMF viva (validateLive), ni la API HTTP, ni mas de una regla distinta; los eventos se comprueban por tipo y orden, no por contenido completo.
limits.en: Does not use a live EMF session (validateLive), the HTTP API or more than one distinct rule; events are checked by type and order, not by full payload.

strengthWhy.es: Orquestador, motor, politica, repositorios y bus reales; oraculo con valores literales; mapeo directo a las tres etapas.
strengthWhy.en: Real orchestrator, engine, policy, repositories and bus; literal-value oracle; direct mapping to the three stages.
